## I2 technical target

Convert the stateless `hft_rmic_futures_accounting_v1` transition primitive into a bounded multi-account/multi-product state subsystem without changing its accounting semantics. The subsystem must:

- isolate state by `(account_id, product_id)`;
- preserve long/short, pending-open and reserved-close quantities;
- apply OPEN/CLOSE reserve/fill/release transitions atomically;
- reject invalid/unconfigured entries fail-closed;
- expose deterministic debug/readback for self-checking tests;
- leave room for committed execution binding without accepting raw/uncommitted reports.

After functional closure, add a committed-report bridge and then measure OOC timing/resources at 156.25 MHz.
